text: Implement valueRationale field in aim data model, MCP create/update_aim, and frontend edit/display
description: As per open aim 2d0ab64b-228e-49d2-80fc-2e43e6c5a893. Add valueRationale (free text or structured) to explain intrinsicValue, especially for root. Update shared types, backend, MCP tools, frontend. Do not auto-derive value. This supports the ASI ideation by making value judgments inspectable and auditable under human authority. Link to cooperation engine or ASI aim.

status.comment: valueRationale is implemented and internally verified across schema, APIs/tools, persistence, and frontend create/edit/display. Awaiting explicit user acceptance before done.

reflection: Implemented valueRationale end-to-end as an optional human-authored explanation that never affects or auto-derives intrinsicValue. Added it to shared persisted/proposal schemas, proposal generation, all backend create/update paths, MCP and loop-worker tool contracts, agent file tools, frontend defaults and creation/edit forms, and the aim value tooltip. Added backend persistence and frontend creation propagation tests. Verification: backend 66/66, shared 29/29, focused MCP aims 13/13, frontend 210/210, core affected builds and frontend production build pass.
